reason: Clarify a previously underspecified temporal preprocessing choice for predictive connectivity after checking the source paper's methods. The source paper used ARIMA residuals over 1979-2018, while PAYOFF-B's existing predictive-connectivity coordinate uses deterministic separate linear detrending. No focal movement event data or cue-uptake coefficient had been opened.

source_method.citation: Resendiz-Infante & Gauthier 2024, Frontiers in Bird Science
source_method.published_processing: fit ARIMA models to each site-period annual temperature series; correlate residuals from selected ARIMA models

frozen_resolution.primary_focal_q: within each 20-year pre-focal window, separately regress source and Bylot annual window-mean temperature on calendar year by OLS; predictive_connectivity_rho is Pearson correlation of the two residual series

forbidden_posthoc_switch: Do not choose OLS versus ARIMA based on the focal GPS cue-uptake result.
